LightningComponentBundle.description: Editable, reorderable installment table for the Create Payment Plan flow. Due dates come from condition months/days; Off-Plan catalogs enter the due date and months/days are derived from Valid From.

property.name: planName
property.label: Payment Plan Name
property.description: Shown as a heading above the installment table.

property.name: numberOfYears
property.label: Number of Years (deprecated)
property.description: Not used - superseded by Number of Months so decimal years are supported. Kept because earlier Create Payment Plan flow versions reference it.

property.name: numberOfMonths
property.label: Number of Months
property.description: Payment plan length in months (Number of Years x 12, rounded). Condition Months/Days on the last installment cannot exceed it; 0 or blank means no limit.

property.name: validFrom
property.label: Valid From
property.description: Payment plan Valid From date. Condition Months/Days count from it; for Off-Plan catalogs they are derived from each installment's Due Date.

property.name: developmentPhase
property.label: Development Phase
property.description: Development Phase of the selected catalog. On-Plan fixes POC at 100%; Off-Plan makes POC mandatory.

property.name: installmentsJson
property.label: Installments (JSON)
property.description: JSON array of installment rows. Store this screen's output into a flow variable to pass into the Create Payment Plan action.
